lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular blobs arranged in approximately six horizontal rows posterior to the gills, with a dense cluster of five spots forming a semi-triangular pattern just superior to the pectoral fin base.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity are visible, intersecting horizontal spot rows to form a grid; intersections are most prominent in the mid-lateral region where spots align with vertical luminance peaks.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a high-contrast gradient with light intensity on the dorsal side and deep shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low to moderate density of high-luminance blobs; approximately 8-10 spots are visible within the first dorsal fin silhouette, concentrated primarily along the lower anterior quadrant.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a remora (Echeneidae) attached ventrally posterior to the pectoral fin; additional small orange-pigmented visual artifact or organism visible near the mid-dorsal ridge.
